raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "an old identity document"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@a2 assumed
  relation "be expired"
  role subject "the old identity document"
  role time "August"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "be able to pick up pension from the post office with"
    role subject "the user"
    role instrument "the old identity document"
    polarity affirmed
  end
